lyrics.ja: 渇いた心で駆け抜ける
lyrics.en: I run through with a parched heart
lyrics.zh: 懷著乾涸的心奔跑穿越

lyrics.ja: ごめんね 何もできなくて
lyrics.en: I'm sorry I couldn't do anything
lyrics.zh: 對不起，我什麼也做不到

lyrics.ja: 痛みを分かち合うことさえ
lyrics.en: Even sharing the pain

lyrics.ja: あなたは許してくれない
lyrics.en: You won't allow me

lyrics.ja: 無垢に生きるため振り向かず
lyrics.en: To live purely, without looking back
lyrics.zh: 為了純真地活下去，頭也不回

lyrics.ja: 背中向けて 去ってしまう
lyrics.en: You turn your back and leave

lyrics.ja: on the lonely rail
lyrics.en: On the lonely rail

lyrics.ja: 私ついていくよ
lyrics.en: I'll follow you

lyrics.ja: どんな辛い世界の闇の中でさえ
lyrics.romaji: Donna Tsurai Sekai no Yami no Naka de Sae
lyrics.en: Even in the darkness of any harsh world
lyrics.zh: 即使身處多麼痛苦的世界的黑暗中

lyrics.ja: きっとあなたは輝いて
lyrics.en: You will surely shine

lyrics.ja: 超える未來の果て
lyrics.en: At the end of the future you surpass

lyrics.ja: 弱さ故に魂こわされぬように
lyrics.romaji: Yowasa Yue ni Tamashii Kowasarenu You ni
lyrics.en: So that your soul won't be broken by weakness
lyrics.zh: 願靈魂不因脆弱而被摧毀

lyrics.ja: my way 重なるよ
lyrics.en: My way overlaps with yours

lyrics.ja: いまふたりに God bless...
lyrics.en: Now, God bless us both...

lyrics.ja: 屆けて熱くなる想いは
lyrics.en: These feelings that grow hot—deliver them
lyrics.zh: 傳達出去，這愈發熾熱的思念

lyrics.ja: 現実溶かしてさまよう
lyrics.en: Melting reality, I wander

lyrics.ja: 會いたい気持ちに理由はない
lyrics.romaji: Aitai Kimochi ni Riyuu ha Nai
lyrics.en: There's no reason for this feeling of wanting to see you
lyrics.zh: 想見你的心情不需要理由

lyrics.ja: あなたへあふれだす Lovin' you
lyrics.en: Overflowing toward you, lovin' you

lyrics.ja: せめて美しい夢だけを
lyrics.en: At least, let's chase only beautiful dreams

lyrics.ja: 描きながら 追いかけよう
lyrics.en: While painting them

lyrics.ja: for your lonely heart
lyrics.en: For your lonely heart

lyrics.ja: やめて噓はあなたらしくないよ
lyrics.romaji: Yamete Uso ha Anata Rashikunai yo
lyrics.en: Stop it—lies don't suit you

lyrics.ja: 目を見てこれからのことを話そう
lyrics.romaji: Me wo Mite Kore kara no Koto wo Hanasou
lyrics.en: Look into my eyes and let's talk about the future
lyrics.zh: 看著我的眼睛，談談今後的事吧

lyrics.ja: 私覚悟してる
lyrics.en: I'm prepared

lyrics.ja: 暗い未來だって
lyrics.en: Even if the future is dark

lyrics.ja: 強くなって運命変えられるかもね
lyrics.romaji: Tsuyoku Natte Unmei Kaerareru Kamo ne
lyrics.en: If we become stronger, maybe we can change fate
lyrics.zh: 變得更強，也許就能改變命運

lyrics.ja: my wish かなえたいのに
lyrics.en: My wish—I want it to come true

lyrics.ja: すべては God knows...
lyrics.en: Everything is up to God knows...

lyrics.ja: あなたがいて 私がいて
lyrics.romaji: Anata ga Ite Watashi ga Ite
lyrics.en: With you here and me here

lyrics.ja: ほかの人は消えてしまった
lyrics.romaji: Hoka no Hito ha Kiete Shimatta
lyrics.en: Other people have disappeared

lyrics.ja: 淡い夢の美しさを描きながら
lyrics.romaji: Awai Yume no Utsukushisa wo Egaki Nagara
lyrics.en: While tracing the beauty of a faint dream

lyrics.ja: 傷跡なぞる
lyrics.en: I trace the scars

lyrics.en: So I'll follow you
